Container.Name: toduck
Container.Overview: Toduck is a local-first task inbox. Every task has a date. Due dates sit on the right and are colored by horizon: overdue, tomorrow, this week, next week, next month, and further out. The Web UI is a compact inbox and an installable PWA, with tags, projects, repeating tasks, search, and import/export. This container serves the Web UI and the /v1/state sync API from one image, so Web and Android clients sync against your own server. Tasks stay in browser storage until a client connects. The auth token is required, must be at least 32 characters, and the container refuses to start without it. Additional users can be created in Settings and receive their own tokens. State is stored as /data/state.json, with state.json.bak kept as the last known good copy; back up that whole path. Use TLS or a trusted private network if you expose Toduck beyond your LAN. The repository above tracks releases (latest). Optional floating tags are ghcr.io/catduckgnaf/toduck:develop and ghcr.io/catduckgnaf/toduck:nightly. Those move only to a Quality-green main commit and are not the default.

Config.Name: Web & Sync Port
Config.Description: Host port for the Web UI and sync API (use 8793 to avoid a collision with Readarr on 8787)

Config.Name: Appdata Storage
Config.Description: Persistent directory for state.json and its state.json.bak backup. Back this up.

Config.Name: Toduck Auth Token
Config.Description: Secret. Admin bearer token used by Web and Android clients to sync; must be at least 32 characters (for example the output of: openssl rand -hex 32). The container refuses to start without it.

Config.Name: Allowed Origins
Config.Description: Optional comma-separated list of origins allowed to call the sync API cross-origin, for example https://tasks.example.com. Leave empty for the normal same-origin Web UI and app use.

Config.Name: Data Path Variable
Config.Description: Internal path to the JSON state file

Config.Name: Static Assets Dir
Config.Description: Internal path to the built Web UI
